name: canvas-text
title: Canvas Text
description: Rasterize a headline into canvas particles that load as a spinning ring, then slowly resolve into letterforms. Zero deps, reduced-motion safe.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>

theme.font-display: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

dark.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/canvas-text.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add canvas-text.
